materials.name: NorCLAD
materials.notes: Low loss, low cost, isotropic microwave laminate of modified PPO, black dielectric, impervious to aqueous processing chemicals. Dk 2.55 +/- 0.05; dielectric strength 500 V/mil measured on 0.125 in; maximum temperature 175 C (short duration) and operating temperature -55 to 125 C; specific gravity 1.12; expansion 53 ppm/C in the three axes (unclad dielectric, ASTM E 831); water absorption 0.06-0.07 %; copper peel 6-8 lb/in. RoHS compliant. Dielectric thicknesses 0.060, 0.090, 0.125, 0.250, 0.375 and 0.500 in.

materials.name: Polyguide
materials.notes: Low cost, low loss microwave laminate of irradiated polyolefin for commercial and CPE antennas and couplers. Dk 2.320 +/- 0.005 at 10 GHz; dielectric strength 500 V/mil measured on 0.020 in; maximum temperature 125 C (short duration) and operating temperature -55 to 175 C; specific gravity 0.95; expansion 108 ppm/C in the three axes (unclad dielectric); water absorption below 0.01 %; copper peel 4-6 lb/in. RoHS compliant. Dielectric thicknesses 0.031, 0.062, 0.125, 0.187 and 0.250 in.

materials.name: Polyflon Bonding Film

lamination.notes: Hot press at 100-125 psi with the bondline at 250-300 F, hold 6-10 min and cool under pressure below 100 F before removing; clean the boards and prime PTFE based dielectric surfaces (sodium etch) first; a thermocouple at the bondline is recommended.

materials.notes: Low flow, low Dk bonding film for stripline circuits made from most microwave/RF laminates; the low bonding temperature suits temperature critical materials. Thickness 0.002 in (51 um); dielectric strength 1000 V/mil (0.002 in); tensile strength 3000 psi nominal and elongation 300 % nominal (ASTM D-882); water absorption below 0.01 %; the sheet lists the specific gravity as 2.15 and the density as 0.929 g/cm3 (the density is stored). Rolls of 24 in x 100 ft (PPBF-200G9) and 36 in x 100 ft (PPBF-200G11). RoHS compliant.
